title: Ecolab to buy CoolIT for $4.75 billion to tap into AI data center boom
content: Ecolab said on Friday it would acquire CoolIT Systems from KKR for about $4.75 billion ‌in cash, as the water solutions firm seeks ‌to capitalize on surging demand for liquid cooling in artificial intelligence-driven data ​centers.  Owned by funds managed by KKR, CoolIT ⁠designs and manufactures liquid cooling systems used by hyperscale and colocation operators.  Ecolab expects CoolIT’s hardware ​and thermal engineering to ‌complement its own strengths in water, chemistry and digital monitoring, helping it turn into a more complete provider of cooling and fluid management.
